definitions.explanation: school activities outside of regular classes, such as clubs, sports teams, and student organizations

examples.japanese: {課外活動|かがいかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
{課外活動|かがいかつどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Extracurricular activities are also taken into account in university admissions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{放課後|ほうかご}→放課後：12720_houkago⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{課外活動|かがいかつどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: I'm busy with extracurricular activities after school.

notes:
{課外活動|かがいかつどう} is the formal umbrella term for school activities outside the curriculum. In everyday speech students name the specific activity, most often ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧ / ⟦{部活動|ぶかつどう}→部活動：14539_bukatsudou⟧: school club activities, by far the largest part of {課外活動|かがいかつどう} at junior and senior high school
- ⟦{課外授業|かがいじゅぎょう}→課外授業：27672_kagaijugyou⟧: extra lessons outside regular class hours — still teaching, not an activity

USAGE:
Appears in school documents, the {内申書|ないしんしょ} (school record for admissions), and job-application forms that ask what you did outside class.
